import { Component, OnInit, ChangeDetectorRef } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-navbar', templateUrl: './navbar.component.html', styleUrls: ['./navbar.component.css'], }) export class NavbarComponent implements OnInit { isLoggedIn = false; username = ''; cartCount = 0; constructor( private router: Router, private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.checkLoginStatus(); // Check login status every time the window gets focus window.addEventListener('focus', () => { this.checkLoginStatus(); }); } checkLoginStatus(): void { const user = localStorage.getItem('username'); const token = localStorage.getItem('token'); this.isLoggedIn = !!(user && user !== 'null' && user !== '' && token); this.username = user || ''; console.log('Navbar Status:', { isLoggedIn: this.isLoggedIn, username: this.username, }); this.cdr.detectChanges(); } logout(): void { if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) { localStorage.clear(); this.isLoggedIn = false; this.username = ''; this.cartCount = 0; alert('Logged out successfully! 👋'); this.router.navigate(['/home']); } } }
